newsitem.title: UK: News of future Russian deals dominates Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: News of future Russian deals dominates Eurobonds.

text.p: The Eurobond primary market had a fairly quiet session on Tuesday with many players focusing on U.S. March CPI figures.
A lot of news surfaced about future Russian Eurobonds.
In particular, Russia said it would issue a dollar Eurobond soon via JP Morgan and SBC Warburg with a maturity of at least five years.

The deal follows a $1.0 billion five-year bond launched last November by Russia and a 2.0 billion mark seven-year deal issued in March. Analysts in Moscow said the money would be used to cover Russia's budget deficit.
Russia's Komi region said it planned to launch a $200 million five-year bond by the end of the year and Russia's biggest confectioner Red October also said it planned to tap the market.

The City of Moscow said it would announce dates for a roadshow marketing its debut Eurobond at the end of this week. The presentations for a five-year deal for up to $500 million were expected to take place in early May.
